title: 索網屋蓋張拉~Cable-net roof tensioning
focus: 以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理~Giving cable nets stiffness through prestress: tensioning strategies for saddle nets and spoked wheels, dual force–geometry control, frequency checks and long-term force management
summary: 索網屋蓋在完成張拉之前只是一堆會晃動的鋼索，預拉力與曲率才讓它具有勁度，因此張拉是設計的一部分而不是單純的施工步驟。課程以 1952 年羅利 Dorton 體育館（世界第一座永久性索支承屋頂，約 300 ft 無柱跨度）、1972 年慕尼黑奧運鞍形索網、卡加利 Saddledome 的索承混凝土雙曲面，以及巴西利亞國家體育場的平衡懸吊輪輻式雙層屋頂為錨點，說明預拉勁度、受壓環、索頭錨具、地面組裝與提升張拉、力與幾何控制、頻率法量索、載重試驗、溫度與鬆弛，以及單索更換的檢核邏輯。~A cable-net roof is only a set of swaying cables until it is tensioned; prestress and curvature give it stiffness, so tensioning is part of the design rather than a mere construction step. Anchored on Raleigh's Dorton Arena of 1952 (the world's first permanent cable-supported roof, about 300 ft clear span), Munich's 1972 Olympic saddle nets, the cable-held concrete saddle of Calgary's Saddledome and the balanced-suspension-wheel double-layer roof of Brasília's National Stadium, the course explains the checking logic for prestress stiffness, compression rings, cable terminations, ground assembly with lift-and-tension, force and geometry control, frequency-based force measurement, load tests, temperature and relaxation, and single-cable replacement.

units.anchor: 預拉力與幾何勁度~Prestress and geometric stiffness
units.title: 索網的勁度來自預拉力與曲率~Cable-net stiffness comes from prestress and curvature
units.mechanism: 單根鋼索在沒有張力時對橫向荷載幾乎沒有抵抗力；施加預拉力後，索在受橫向力而偏轉時，張力的分量會把它拉回，這種由張力與幾何產生的勁度稱為幾何勁度。索網就是利用這個原理：兩組曲率相反的索互相預拉，任何方向的荷載都會讓一組增張、一組減張，網面因此能承受上下兩種荷載。預拉力越大，網越硬，但索、錨具與邊界構件的受力也越大，因此預拉力是勁度、變形與構件尺寸之間的設計權衡，而不是越大越好。~A cable with no tension offers almost no resistance to lateral load; once prestressed, any lateral deflection tilts the tension so that a component pulls the cable back, a stiffness arising from tension and geometry called geometric stiffness. Cable nets exploit this: two families of opposite curvature are prestressed against each other, and load in any direction increases tension in one family and decreases it in the other, so the surface can carry both downward and upward loads. More prestress makes the net stiffer but also increases forces in cables, anchorages and boundary members, so prestress is a design trade-off among stiffness, deformation and member size rather than something to maximise.
units.model: 拉直的預拉索在跨中受集中力時，幾何勁度 k = 4T/L。T = 200 kN、L = 40 m：k = 4×200/40 = 20 kN/m，10 kN 的集中力造成約 0.5 m 撓度；預拉力加倍為 400 kN，k = 40 kN/m，撓度減半為 0.25 m。此式忽略索的彈性伸長與初始垂度。數值為教學假設。~A straight prestressed cable loaded at midspan has geometric stiffness k = 4T/L. With T = 200 kN and L = 40 m, k = 4×200/40 = 20 kN/m, so a 10 kN point load deflects it about 0.5 m; doubling prestress to 400 kN gives k = 40 kN/m and halves the deflection to 0.25 m. The formula ignores elastic stretch and initial sag. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以幾何非線性分析計算不同預拉力水準下網面的最大變形、最小索力與最大索力，畫出預拉力—變形—構件尺寸的關係，選出滿足變形限值、所有組合不鬆弛且構件經濟的預拉力，並把選定值與理由寫入設計基準。~Compute maximum deformation, minimum and maximum cable force for several prestress levels by geometrically nonlinear analysis, plot the relation between prestress, deformation and member size, choose the prestress that meets deformation limits, avoids slack in every combination and keeps members economic, and record the chosen value and its rationale in the design basis.
units.failure: 預拉力取得過低，網面在風中大幅擺動，覆面材料與接縫反覆變形而破損；取得過高，則邊界受壓環、桅桿與基礎都必須加大，而且索在長期高應力下鬆弛與疲勞風險上升。~Too little prestress lets the surface swing widely in wind, so cladding and joints are damaged by repeated deformation; too much forces larger compression rings, masts and foundations and raises relaxation and fatigue risk in cables kept at high stress for decades.
units.misconception: 索網的預拉力越大越安全。~The more prestress a cable net has, the safer it is.
units.practice: 設計基準要說明預拉力選定的依據（變形限值、最小索力、構件經濟性），並列出各索的目標預拉力與允許範圍，作為張拉驗收與日後檢測的共同標準。~The design basis should explain how prestress was chosen (deformation limits, minimum cable force, member economy) and list each cable's target prestress and allowable range as the shared standard for tensioning acceptance and later inspection.

units.anchor: 受壓環與輪輻式系統~Compression ring and spoked wheel
units.title: 鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的傳力~Load paths of saddle nets and spoked-wheel roofs
units.mechanism: 索屋蓋最終都要把索力閉合在受壓構件上。Dorton 體育館的鞍形索網張在兩道交叉的拋物線混凝土拱之間，拱在地面以上約 26 ft 處交叉並延伸入地下，兩端以鋼索拉結，拱受壓、索受拉，外牆幾乎不承重。輪輻式屋蓋則像腳踏車輪：外圈受壓環、內圈受拉環，以徑向索相連；巴西利亞國家體育場採用平衡懸吊輪原理的雙層懸吊屋頂，與外側受壓環同心。兩種系統的共同點是內力在結構內部自我平衡，基礎主要承受豎向力。~Every cable roof must close its cable forces on compression members. Dorton Arena's saddle net is stretched between two intersecting parabolic concrete arches that cross about 26 ft above ground and continue underground, where their ends are tied by steel cables, so the arches work in compression, the cables in tension and the outer walls carry almost no load. A spoked-wheel roof is like a bicycle wheel: an outer compression ring and inner tension ring connected by radial cables; Brasília's National Stadium uses a double-layer suspended roof on the balanced suspension-wheel principle, concentric with its outer compression ring. Both systems balance their internal forces within the structure, leaving foundations mainly with vertical load.
units.model: 圓形受壓環受均布徑向力 q 時環力 N = q·R。若 n = 60 根徑向索各提供水平力 H = 3,000 kN，q = nH/(2πR)，故 N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN，與半徑無關；但 R = 120 m 時 q ≈ 239 kN/m，平面內挫屈需另行檢核。數值為教學假設。~A circular compression ring under uniform radial load q has a ring force N = q·R. If n = 60 radial cables each supply H = 3,000 kN, q = nH/(2πR), so N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN, independent of radius; with R = 120 m, q ≈ 239 kN/m and in-plane buckling must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以整體模型確認索力在受壓環、拱或邊界構件中閉合，基礎反力以豎向為主；檢查不對稱荷載（半邊雪、單側風）下受壓環的彎矩與變形，並確認任何一根索失效時系統仍可維持穩定。~Confirm in the global model that cable forces close in the compression ring, arches or boundary members, leaving foundation reactions mainly vertical; check ring bending and deformation under asymmetric loads such as half-span snow or one-sided wind, and confirm the system stays stable if any one cable is lost.
units.failure: 受壓環只按對稱荷載設計，不對稱荷載下環的彎矩被低估，環扭曲後徑向索張力重新分配，部分索鬆弛、部分過載；拱腳拉結索若腐蝕失效，拱腳外推，整個鞍形網的幾何與預拉力同時喪失。~A compression ring designed only for symmetric load underestimates ring bending under asymmetric load; as the ring distorts, radial tensions redistribute so some cables slacken and others overload; if the tie cables at arch feet corrode and fail, the feet spread and the saddle net loses its geometry and prestress at once.
units.misconception: 輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環只承受均勻壓力，不需要考慮彎矩。~A spoked-wheel compression ring carries only uniform compression and needs no bending check.
units.practice: 設計報告應以示意圖標出每一個索力閉合路徑，並列出基礎只承受豎向力的前提條件；拱腳拉結索、受壓環接頭等關鍵閉合構件應設計為可檢查，並在維護手冊中列為一級檢查項目。~The design report should map every closed cable-force path in diagrams and state the conditions under which foundations carry only vertical load; key closing components such as arch-foot ties and compression-ring joints should be inspectable and listed as top-priority items in the maintenance manual.

units.anchor: 索頭錨具與可調量~Terminations and adjustment
units.title: 索體型式、索頭錨具與可調量~Cable types, end terminations and adjustment range
units.mechanism: 索網常用三種索體：螺旋鋼索（柔軟、適合鞍形網）、全封閉鋼索（外層 Z 形鋼絲緊扣、耐蝕且勁度較高，常用於邊索）、平行鋼絞線束（勁度高、可逐根更換，常用於大力量的拉索）。索頭以澆鑄鋅或樹脂的套筒、或壓製接頭與結構連接，並以螺桿或墊片提供可調長度。索在出廠前常做預拉處理，消除鋼絲初始排列造成的永久伸長，否則安裝後索會慢慢變長而流失預拉力。可調量必須同時涵蓋製造、量測溫度與施工誤差。~Cable nets commonly use three cable types: spiral strand (flexible, suited to saddle nets), locked-coil rope (outer Z-shaped wires interlock, corrosion-resistant and stiffer, often used for edge cables) and parallel-strand bundles (high stiffness and replaceable strand by strand, common for heavily loaded stays). Terminations use zinc- or resin-cast sockets or swaged fittings connected to the structure, with threaded rods or shims giving adjustable length. Cables are usually pre-stretched in the factory to remove the permanent bedding-in extension of the wires; otherwise they slowly lengthen after installation and lose prestress. The adjustment range must cover fabrication, measuring temperature and construction tolerances together.
units.model: 80 m 長的索若製造允差為 L/5,000，即 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm；再加上受壓環與基礎的施工誤差 ±30 mm，以及量測溫差 15°C 造成的 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm，簡單相加約 60 mm，索頭可調量至少應有 ±60 mm，並保留餘裕。允差與溫差為教學假設。~An 80 m cable with a fabrication tolerance of L/5,000 has 80,000/5,000 = 16 mm; adding ±30 mm of compression-ring and foundation construction error and a 15°C measuring-temperature difference worth 12×10⁻⁶×80,000×15 ≈ 14 mm gives about 60 mm by simple addition, so terminations need at least ±60 mm of adjustment with some margin. Tolerances and temperature are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 索出廠前核對預拉處理紀錄、在規定荷載與溫度下的長度量測與標記；索頭澆鑄做抽樣破斷或保證荷載試驗；現場安裝前確認每個索頭的可調螺桿長度與螺紋狀態，並記錄初始調整位置。~Before shipment check pre-stretching records and length measurement and marking under the specified load and temperature; sample socket castings for break or proof-load tests; on site before installation confirm each termination's threaded adjustment length and thread condition and record the initial adjustment position.
units.failure: 未經預拉處理的螺旋鋼索在使用初期持續伸長，預拉力在數月內明顯下降；可調量不足時，現場被迫在索頭加接墊片或延長件，若未經設計，可能形成彎曲或偏心受力的弱點。~Spiral strand not pre-stretched keeps lengthening early in service, and prestress drops noticeably within months; with too little adjustment, crews are forced to add shims or extensions at terminations, which, if not designed, create weak points loaded in bending or eccentrically.
units.misconception: 鋼索出廠長度正確，就不會在安裝後變長。~A cable delivered at the correct length will not lengthen after installation.
units.practice: 索的採購規範應寫明索體型式、最小破斷力、彈性模數範圍、預拉處理要求、長度量測條件、索頭型式與可調量；可調量用盡時應停工檢討原因，不得現場臨時加接。~The cable procurement specification should state cable type, minimum breaking load, modulus range, pre-stretching requirement, length-measuring conditions, termination type and adjustment range; when adjustment runs out, work stops for review rather than improvised extensions.

units.anchor: 受壓環挫屈與索端節點~Ring buckling and cable-end nodes
units.title: 受壓環穩定與索端節點細部~Compression-ring stability and cable-end node details
units.mechanism: 受壓環承受數萬 kN 的環向壓力，同時被每根徑向索以集中力拉向圓心，平面內與平面外挫屈都是主要檢核。索端節點把集中索力傳入環梁，需要足夠的承壓板、加勁與錨定長度，並允許索在不同荷載下改變角度而不在索頭產生彎曲。節點也要預留張拉千斤頂的作業空間與日後更換索的通路；若節點設計只考慮完成狀態，張拉時千斤頂無處安放，或更換時必須破壞節點。~A compression ring carries tens of thousands of kilonewtons of hoop compression while every radial cable pulls it inward with a concentrated force, so in-plane and out-of-plane buckling are primary checks. Cable-end nodes transfer concentrated forces into the ring through adequate bearing plates, stiffeners and anchorage length, and must let the cable change angle under different loads without bending at the socket. Nodes must also leave room for tensioning jacks and access for future cable replacement; if designed only for the final state, there is nowhere to place jacks during tensioning, or the node must be destroyed to replace a cable.
units.model: 圓環在均勻徑向壓力下的平面內彈性挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³。要求 q_cr ≥ 2.5q，q = 239 kN/m、R = 120 m：EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m²，以鋼材 E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m² 計，I ≥ 1.64 m⁴。若半徑改為 100 m，所需 EI 降為約 58%。數值為教學假設。~A circular ring under uniform radial pressure buckles in plane at q_cr = 3EI/R³. Requiring q_cr ≥ 2.5q with q = 239 kN/m and R = 120 m gives EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m², so with steel E = 2.1×10⁸ kN/m², I ≥ 1.64 m⁴. With a 100 m radius the required EI drops to about 58%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以考慮幾何非線性與初始缺陷的分析檢查受壓環的挫屈安全係數；索端節點以有限元素檢查局部承壓與加勁，並以足尺或縮尺試驗驗證關鍵節點；節點製作後量測錨定面角度，確保索軸線與錨定面垂直。~Check the compression ring's buckling safety factor by analysis including geometric nonlinearity and initial imperfections; check cable-end nodes for local bearing and stiffening by finite elements and verify key nodes by full- or reduced-scale tests; after fabrication measure anchor-face angles to keep the cable axis perpendicular to the bearing face.
units.failure: 錨定面角度偏差使索頭承受彎曲，鋼絲在套筒出口處疲勞斷裂；受壓環若製造時的圓度偏差過大，等於增加初始缺陷，挫屈荷載顯著降低，在不對稱荷載下出現過大的面外變形。~Anchor faces at the wrong angle bend the socket so wires fatigue and break at the socket exit; excessive out-of-roundness of the compression ring acts as an initial imperfection that markedly lowers its buckling load, leading to large out-of-plane deformation under asymmetric load.
units.misconception: 受壓環只要斷面夠大承受軸壓，就不會挫屈。~A compression ring with enough area for its axial force cannot buckle.
units.practice: 受壓環的圓度與高程允差、索端節點的角度允差都要寫入製造與安裝規範並逐點量測；節點圖須同時畫出張拉千斤頂與更換工具的位置，由結構設計者確認可施工、可維護。~Write ring roundness and level tolerances and node angle tolerances into the fabrication and erection specification and measure them point by point; node drawings must show tensioning-jack and replacement-tool positions, confirmed buildable and maintainable by the structural designer.

units.anchor: 提升張拉的最後行程~Final stroke of lift-and-tension
units.title: 輪輻式索網的地面組裝、提升與張拉~Ground assembly, lifting and tensioning of spoked-wheel nets
units.mechanism: 大型輪輻式屋蓋常在看台或場地上把徑向索、受拉環與索夾組成整張網，再以多台鋼絞線千斤頂同時拉起徑向索端，一路把網提升到受壓環高度並張緊，最後插銷錨固。提升初期索網懸垂、所需拉力小；接近錨點時索開始被拉直，彈性伸長主導，拉力在最後幾十公分內急遽上升到設計值。因此最後行程的控制最關鍵：所有千斤頂必須同步，臨時延伸桿要能承受全力，插銷時索力已接近完成狀態。~Large spoked-wheel roofs are often assembled on the stands or field into a complete net of radial cables, tension ring and clamps, then many strand jacks pull the radial cable ends simultaneously, raising the net to compression-ring level and tightening it before the ends are pinned. Early in the lift the net hangs slack and little force is needed; near the anchors the cables straighten and elastic stretch takes over, so force climbs steeply to its design value within the last few tens of centimetres. Control of the final stroke is therefore most critical: all jacks must be synchronised, temporary extension bars must carry full force, and when the pins go in the cable force is already close to its final state.
units.model: 徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 L = 100 m，軸向勁度 k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m。設計索力 3,000 kN 對應的彈性伸長為 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m，也就是最後 0.5 m 的行程內力量由接近 0 升到 3,000 kN，每 100 mm 約增加 600 kN。數值為教學假設。~A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length L = 100 m has an axial stiffness k = EA/L = 6,000 kN/m. Its design force of 3,000 kN corresponds to an elastic stretch of 3,000/6,000 = 0.5 m, so within the last 0.5 m of stroke the force rises from near zero to 3,000 kN, about 600 kN for every 100 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析預測提升全程各千斤頂的力—行程曲線，特別標出最後行程的勁度；提升中逐行程記錄力與行程並與曲線比較，偏差超過門檻即停止；插銷前量測索端與錨孔的相對位置，確認同步與幾何後才插銷。~Predict each jack's force–stroke curve over the whole lift by construction-stage analysis, highlighting the final-stroke stiffness; during the lift record force and stroke at each stroke and compare with the curve, stopping when deviation exceeds the threshold; before pinning measure the relative position of cable ends and anchor holes and pin only after synchronisation and geometry are confirmed.
units.failure: 最後行程中某台千斤頂落後，因勁度極高，相鄰索的力瞬間升高數百 kN，臨時延伸桿或吊耳超載斷裂；以為力量已到卻是摩擦造成的假讀數，插銷後索力不足，網面形狀偏離設計。~If one jack lags during the final stroke, the very high stiffness raises force in neighbouring cables by hundreds of kilonewtons in moments, overloading and breaking temporary extension bars or lugs; a false reading caused by friction can suggest force has been reached when it has not, leaving the cable short of force after pinning and the surface off its design shape.
units.misconception: 提升張拉時最難的是剛離地的時候，接近完成時只要慢慢拉就好。~The hardest part of lift-and-tension is lift-off; near completion the jacks simply pull slowly.
units.practice: 提升張拉計畫須把最後行程獨立成一個階段，規定較小的行程增量、同步門檻、量測頻率與決策人；臨時延伸桿與吊耳要依最大力設計並有試驗紀錄，本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際作業須依核准程序執行。~The lift-and-tension plan must treat the final stroke as a separate stage with smaller stroke increments, synchronisation thresholds, measurement frequency and a named decision-maker; temporary extension bars and lugs must be designed for maximum force with test records, and this course explains checking logic only, actual work following an approved procedure.

units.anchor: 力與幾何雙重控制~Dual force and geometry control
units.title: 張拉控制：以力為主還是以幾何為主~Tensioning control: force-led or geometry-led
units.mechanism: 張拉驗收有兩種主軸：以力控制（每根索拉到目標力，形狀隨之產生）與以幾何控制（每根索拉到目標長度或銷孔位置，力隨之產生）。固定長度的索網本質上是幾何控制，力由索長決定；可調索則可以力控制。實務上兩者要互相驗證：力對了但幾何偏差大，代表索長或邊界有誤；幾何對了但力偏差大，代表勁度或摩擦假設有誤。哪一個量比較敏感，取決於索的垂度：垂度越淺，長度誤差造成的力誤差越大。卡加利 Saddledome 施工時，混凝土板需要多次調整才能嵌入索之間，也顯示索網幾何與覆面構件之間的配合難度。~Tensioning acceptance has two axes: force control, pulling each cable to a target force and letting shape follow, and geometry control, pulling each cable to a target length or pin position and letting force follow. A net of fixed-length cables is essentially geometry-controlled, its forces set by cable lengths, while adjustable cables allow force control. In practice the two must cross-check: correct force with large geometric deviation points to cable-length or boundary errors, while correct geometry with large force deviation points to wrong stiffness or friction assumptions. Which quantity is more sensitive depends on sag: the shallower the sag, the larger the force error from a length error. At Calgary's Saddledome the concrete slabs needed numerous adjustments to fit between the cables, showing how hard it is to match net geometry with cladding elements.
units.model: 近似不伸長的垂索，長度變化 ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L)，且 ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f，合併得 ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²)。L = 40 m、ΔS = 10 mm：垂度 f = 2.0 m 時張力誤差約 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9%；f = 0.8 m 時約 11.7%，敏感度隨 1/f² 增加。忽略彈性伸長，數值為教學假設。~For a nearly inextensible sagging cable, the length change is ΔS ≈ 16f·Δf/(3L) and ΔH/H ≈ Δf/f, so ΔH/H ≈ 3L·ΔS/(16f²). With L = 40 m and ΔS = 10 mm, a sag f = 2.0 m gives about 3×40×0.01/(16×4) ≈ 1.9% tension error, while f = 0.8 m gives about 11.7%: sensitivity grows as 1/f². Elastic stretch is ignored and the values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 驗收準則同時列出力與幾何兩組允差（例如索力 ±10%、節點座標 ±30 mm），並依各索垂度決定以哪一項為主控；量測後若只有一項超出，依前述邏輯判斷原因，再由設計者決定調整索長、邊界或接受偏差。~Set acceptance criteria for both force and geometry, for example cable force ±10% and node coordinates ±30 mm, deciding from each cable's sag which one governs; if only one is exceeded after measurement, diagnose the cause by the logic above and let the designer decide whether to adjust cable length, adjust boundaries or accept the deviation.
units.failure: 只以千斤頂力驗收，淺垂度區索長偏短卻因摩擦讀數看似正確，實際張力遠高於設計；只以幾何驗收，則錨具摩擦或邊界變形造成的力誤差被忽略。覆面構件若在索網幾何未穩定時就安裝，往往需要大量現場修改。~Accepting by jack force alone can miss a short cable in a shallow zone whose friction-affected reading looks right while its real tension is far above design; accepting by geometry alone ignores force errors caused by anchorage friction or boundary deformation. Installing cladding before net geometry has stabilised often demands extensive site modification.
units.misconception: 張拉只要每根索都拉到設計力，形狀自然就正確。~If every cable is pulled to its design force, the shape will automatically be right.
units.practice: 張拉程序書須寫明主控量（力或幾何）、副控量與兩者的允差，並規定覆面構件只能在索網張拉驗收完成後安裝；任何超出允差的處置都須由結構設計者書面決定。~The tensioning procedure must state the governing quantity, force or geometry, the secondary one and tolerances for both, and allow cladding installation only after net tensioning has been accepted; any action on out-of-tolerance results must be decided in writing by the structural designer.

units.anchor: 頻率法量測索力~Frequency method for cable force
units.title: 以振動頻率量測索力~Measuring cable force from vibration frequency
units.mechanism: 完成的索網大多數索沒有千斤頂可以頂升量測，因此常用振動頻率法：在索上裝加速度計，記錄環境振動或輕敲後的自由振動，找出基本頻率，再以張緊弦公式反算張力。這方法快速、非破壞，適合大量索的普查與長期監測；但索的有效長度（索夾與錨具的約束位置）、抗彎勁度與垂度都會影響頻率，短而粗的索誤差尤其大。因此需要先在可以頂升量測的索上校正，再推廣到其他索。~Most cables in a finished net have no jack for a lift-off test, so the vibration frequency method is common: an accelerometer on the cable records ambient or tap-induced free vibration, the fundamental frequency is identified and tension back-calculated with the taut-string formula. The method is fast and non-destructive, suiting surveys of many cables and long-term monitoring; but effective length (where clamps and anchorages restrain the cable), bending stiffness and sag all affect frequency, with especially large errors for short, thick cables. It is therefore calibrated first on cables that can be lift-off tested and then extended to the others.
units.model: 張緊弦 T = 4mL²f₁²。單位長質量 m = 25 kg/m、有效長度 L = 40 m、量得基頻 f₁ = 2.0 Hz：T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN。因 T 與 L² 成正比，有效長度若誤估 2%，張力誤差約 4%；頻率誤差 2% 也造成約 4% 的張力誤差。數值為教學假設。~For a taut string T = 4mL²f₁². With mass per length m = 25 kg/m, effective length L = 40 m and a measured fundamental f₁ = 2.0 Hz: T = 4×25×40²×2.0² = 640,000 N = 640 kN. Because T scales with L², a 2% error in effective length gives about 4% error in tension, and a 2% frequency error also about 4%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 選擇數根可頂升量測的索，同時做頂升試驗與頻率量測，求出修正係數（含抗彎勁度與邊界條件）；量測時記錄溫度與風況，取多個高階頻率檢查是否符合等差關係，以判斷弦公式是否適用；結果與分析預測及完工基準比較。~Choose several cables that can be lift-off tested and do both lift-off and frequency measurements to derive correction factors for bending stiffness and boundary conditions; record temperature and wind, and check whether several higher frequencies follow an arithmetic series to judge whether the string formula applies; compare results with predictions and the as-built baseline.
units.failure: 未校正就以理論公式計算短索的張力，抗彎勁度使頻率偏高，算出的張力被高估，鬆弛的索被誤判為正常；有效長度量錯（例如把索夾當成自由），整批資料系統性偏差。~Applying the theoretical formula to short cables without calibration lets bending stiffness raise the frequency so tension is overestimated and slack cables pass as normal; a wrong effective length, such as treating a clamp as free, biases a whole data set systematically.
units.misconception: 頻率法只要量到頻率，就能直接準確算出任何索的張力。~With a measured frequency, the frequency method gives every cable's tension accurately and directly.
units.practice: 頻率法量測計畫要寫明感測器位置、取樣長度、有效長度定義、校正方法與各索的修正係數，結果附原始頻譜；監測系統的索與完工基準使用同一套修正係數，才能比較長期變化。~A frequency-method plan should state sensor positions, record length, effective-length definition, calibration method and each cable's correction factor, with raw spectra attached; monitored cables should use the same correction factors as the as-built baseline so long-term changes are comparable.

units.anchor: 水袋載重試驗~Water-bag load test
units.title: 完工載重試驗與節點變位驗證~Completion load test and node-displacement check
units.mechanism: 載重試驗直接驗證索網在已知荷載下的勁度是否與分析一致，是確認預拉力與幾何的整體方法。常以水袋或砂袋在指定區域施加均布荷載，量測代表性節點的撓度、相鄰索力與邊界構件變形，卸載後再量測恢復量。若實測撓度明顯大於預測，可能預拉力偏低或索的模數較小；若無法恢復，可能有索夾滑移或錨具沉陷。試驗荷載要分級施加，並在每一級確認沒有異常後才繼續。~A load test checks directly whether the net's stiffness under known load matches the analysis, an overall confirmation of prestress and geometry. Water or sand bags apply uniform load over a defined area, and deflection at representative nodes, adjacent cable forces and boundary-member deformation are measured, then recovery after unloading. Measured deflection clearly above prediction suggests low prestress or a lower cable modulus; incomplete recovery suggests clamp slip or anchorage settlement. Test load is applied in stages, each continuing only when no anomaly is seen.
units.model: 在 20 m × 20 m 區域施加 0.5 kPa 水袋荷載，總荷載 0.5×400 = 200 kN。預測中心撓度 85 mm，實測 98 mm，超出約 15%；若驗收準則為實測不超過預測的 1.10 倍，則不合格，需檢查預拉力。卸載後殘留 6 mm，恢復率 (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%，若準則為 90% 則合格。數值為教學假設。~Water bags at 0.5 kPa over a 20 m × 20 m area give a total of 0.5×400 = 200 kN. The predicted centre deflection is 85 mm and the measured 98 mm, about 15% higher; against a criterion of measured not more than 1.10 times predicted this fails and prestress must be checked. A 6 mm residual after unloading means a recovery of (98 − 6)/98 ≈ 94%, passing a 90% criterion. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫事先寫明荷載區域、分級、停留時間、量測點、預測值與允收準則；量測在溫度穩定時段進行並記錄溫度；每一級比較實測與預測，超出警戒即停止加載；試驗後檢查索夾標記與錨具。~The test plan states in advance the loaded area, stages, hold times, measurement points, predictions and acceptance criteria; measure at stable temperature and record it; compare measured and predicted at each stage and stop loading at the alarm level; inspect clamp marks and anchorages after the test.
units.failure: 一次把全部荷載放上去，若網面某處已鬆弛，荷載集中使覆面撕裂或索夾滑移；忽略溫度變化，把日照造成的撓度變化誤當成荷載效應，得出錯誤的勁度結論。~Applying the whole load at once can, where the net is already slack, concentrate load, tear cladding or slip clamps; ignoring temperature change can mistake solar-induced deflection for load effect and give wrong stiffness conclusions.
units.misconception: 索網結構很柔，載重試驗量到大撓度是正常的，不必和預測比較。~A cable net is flexible, so large deflection in a load test is normal and need not be compared with prediction.
units.practice: 載重試驗須由結構設計者訂定準則並在場見證，水袋加卸載與人員進出屬高處作業，須依核准程序執行；試驗結果與張拉驗收一起作為完工基準移交。~The structural designer sets the load-test criteria and witnesses the test; placing and removing water bags and access are work at height to be done under an approved procedure; results are handed over together with tensioning acceptance as the as-built baseline.

units.anchor: 日照溫差與鬆弛漂移~Solar temperature and relaxation drift
units.title: 溫度、鬆弛與潛變造成的索力漂移~Cable-force drift from temperature, relaxation and creep
units.mechanism: 鋼索在日照下升溫比混凝土受壓環快，索伸長而索力下降；冬夜則相反。對拉直的徑向索而言，幾度的溫差就能造成數個百分比的力變化，因此量測與驗收都要做溫度修正。長期來看，鋼絲應力鬆弛、索頭澆鑄材料潛變與鍍鋅層變形，都會讓索力緩慢流失；全封閉鋼索與平行鋼絞線束的行為也不同。監測系統的任務是把這些可預期的漂移與真正的異常（斷絲、錨具滑移、邊界沉陷）分開。~Steel cables warm in sunshine faster than a concrete compression ring, lengthening and losing force; on winter nights the opposite happens. For a straight radial cable a few degrees of difference can change force by several percent, so measurements and acceptance need temperature correction. In the long term, wire stress relaxation, creep of socket filler and deformation of zinc coatings slowly reduce force, and locked-coil ropes and parallel strands behave differently. A monitoring system must separate these expected drifts from true anomalies such as broken wires, anchorage slip or boundary settlement.
units.model: 徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN，若索比受壓環高溫 20°C，索力變化 ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN，約為設計索力 3,000 kN 的 4.8%。若再假設長期鬆弛 2%，冬季低溫時與夏季日照時的索力差可接近 7%。溫差與鬆弛率為教學假設。~For a radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN running 20°C warmer than the compression ring, the force change is ΔT ≈ EA·α·ΔT_diff = 600,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 144 kN, about 4.8% of a 3,000 kN design force. With an assumed 2% long-term relaxation, the difference between cold winter and sunny summer force can approach 7%. Temperature difference and relaxation rate are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性索與受壓環上同時量測溫度，建立索力—溫差回歸關係，把監測資料修正到參考溫度後再看趨勢；每年比較修正後的索力與完工基準，扣除預期鬆弛後若仍有超出門檻的下降，啟動頂升量測與目視檢查。~Measure temperatures on representative cables and on the compression ring together, establish a force–temperature-difference regression and correct monitoring data to the reference temperature before reading trends; each year compare corrected forces with the as-built baseline, and if a drop beyond the threshold remains after allowing for expected relaxation, trigger lift-off measurement and visual inspection.
units.failure: 未做溫度修正的監測資料隨季節大幅擺盪，真正的異常被淹沒在雜訊裡；反之把正常的季節變化當成異常，頻繁要求重新張拉，反而使索與錨具承受不必要的循環。~Uncorrected monitoring data swing widely with the seasons, burying real anomalies in noise; conversely, treating normal seasonal change as an anomaly leads to frequent re-tensioning that subjects cables and anchorages to unnecessary cycles.
units.misconception: 索力監測讀數變化就代表結構出了問題。~Any change in monitored cable force means the structure has a problem.
units.practice: 監測報告應同時呈現原始與溫度修正後的索力、所用修正模型、預期鬆弛曲線與警戒門檻；警戒觸發後的處置流程與決策人要事先寫入維護手冊。~Monitoring reports should show raw and temperature-corrected forces, the correction model used, the expected relaxation curve and alarm thresholds; the response procedure and decision-maker after an alarm must be written into the maintenance manual in advance.

units.anchor: 單索更換與冗餘~Single-cable replacement and redundancy
units.title: 單索失效、更換工程與交接~Single-cable loss, replacement engineering and handover
units.mechanism: 索網的使用年限常與建築相同，但個別索可能因腐蝕、斷絲或索頭問題需要更換。設計時就要回答：任何一根索失效時，相鄰索能否暫時承擔它的力而不連鎖破壞；更換時如何用臨時旁通索或千斤頂把力轉移出去，再分階段放鬆、拆除與安裝新索。Dorton 體育館 1952 年完成、2002 年獲 ASCE 列為國家歷史土木工程地標，這類歷史索結構的保存更依賴完整的原始資料與歷次檢修紀錄；卡加利 Saddledome 屋頂無法承受某些巡迴演出的重型吊掛，也提醒營運限制必須在交接時寫清楚。~A cable net often shares the building's service life, yet individual cables may need replacement because of corrosion, broken wires or termination problems. Design must answer whether neighbouring cables can temporarily carry a lost cable's force without progressive failure, and how, during replacement, a temporary bypass cable or jacks can take the force out so the old cable can be released, removed and replaced in stages. Dorton Arena, completed in 1952 and designated a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by ASCE in 2002, shows that conserving historic cable structures depends even more on complete original data and repair records; Calgary's Saddledome roof cannot carry the heavy rigs of some touring shows, a reminder that operating limits must be written clearly at handover.
units.model: 某徑向索設計力 H = 3,000 kN、最小破斷力 9,000 kN（安全係數 3.0）。若該索失效、其力由兩側相鄰索各分擔一半，相鄰索升至 3,000 + 1,500 = 4,500 kN，利用率 4,500/9,000 = 0.50，剩餘安全係數 2.0。若相鄰索已因腐蝕損失 20% 斷面，破斷力約 7,200 kN，係數降到 1.6。數值為教學假設。~A radial cable has design force H = 3,000 kN and minimum breaking load 9,000 kN (safety factor 3.0). If it fails and its force is shared equally by the two neighbours, they rise to 3,000 + 1,500 = 4,500 kN, a utilisation of 4,500/9,000 = 0.50 and a residual safety factor of 2.0. If a neighbour has already lost 20% of its section to corrosion, its breaking load is about 7,200 kN and the factor drops to 1.6. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計階段做單索移除分析，確認各情境下相鄰索、索夾與受壓環的利用率；更換工程前以頂升與頻率法量測相鄰索現況，擬定臨時旁通與分階段放鬆程序，每一階段量測相鄰索力與網面幾何，確認符合分析後才繼續。~At design stage run single-cable-removal analyses to confirm utilisation of neighbouring cables, clamps and compression ring in each scenario; before replacement measure neighbouring cables by lift-off and frequency methods, plan temporary bypass and staged release, and at each stage measure neighbouring forces and net geometry, continuing only when they match the analysis.
units.failure: 未做單索失效分析的索網，一根索因腐蝕斷裂後相鄰索超載接連斷裂，形成連鎖破壞；更換時直接切斷舊索，儲存的應變能瞬間釋放，索端甩動傷人並使網面劇烈變形。~A net without single-cable-loss analysis can lose one corroded cable and then see neighbours overload and break in sequence, a progressive collapse; cutting an old cable directly during replacement releases its stored strain energy instantly, whipping the cable end dangerously and jolting the net.
units.misconception: 索網的每根索都很強，所以不需要考慮任何一根失效的情況。~Every cable in a net is strong, so the loss of any single cable need not be considered.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含索的編號與規格表、完工索力與幾何基準、單索移除分析、更換程序與臨時措施、可吊掛點與荷載上限；索的更換屬高能量作業，須由結構工程師設計程序並依核准流程執行，絕不可直接切斷受力中的索。~Handover should include a cable numbering and specification table, as-built force and geometry baselines, single-cable-removal analyses, replacement procedure and temporary measures, and permitted rigging points and load limits; cable replacement is high-energy work whose procedure must be designed by the structural engineer and carried out under an approved process, and a loaded cable must never simply be cut.

example: 設計練習：輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環與最後張拉行程。屋蓋有 n = 60 根徑向索，每根設計水平力 H = 3,000 kN，受壓環半徑 R = 120 m。（1）環力 N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN；均布徑向力 q = N/R ≈ 239 kN/m。（2）環的平面內挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³，要求 q_cr ≥ 2.5q，需 EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m²。（3）徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 100 m，勁度 6,000 kN/m，最後 0.5 m 行程內力量由近 0 升到 3,000 kN；若一台千斤頂落後 30 mm，該索少 180 kN、相鄰索相應增加，約為 6%。（4）若把徑向索數增為 72 根並維持相同總力，每根 H = 2,500 kN，最後行程縮為約 0.42 m，單根同步誤差 30 mm 的力差仍為 180 kN，但比例升為約 7.2%，同步要求更嚴。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。~Design exercise: compression ring and final tensioning stroke of a spoked-wheel roof. The roof has n = 60 radial cables, each with design horizontal force H = 3,000 kN, and a compression ring of radius R = 120 m. (1) Ring force N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN; uniform radial load q = N/R ≈ 239 kN/m. (2) In-plane ring buckling q_cr = 3EI/R³ with q_cr ≥ 2.5q requires EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m². (3) A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length 100 m has stiffness 6,000 kN/m, so in the last 0.5 m of stroke its force rises from near zero to 3,000 kN; a jack lagging 30 mm leaves that cable 180 kN short, with neighbours correspondingly higher, about 6%. (4) Increasing to 72 radial cables with the same total force gives H = 2,500 kN each and a final stroke of about 0.42 m; a 30 mm synchronisation error still means 180 kN, but now about 7.2%, so synchronisation requirements tighten. All values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: Matthew Nowicki 設計、Fred Severud 擔任結構顧問的羅利 Dorton 體育館於 1952 年完成，以兩道交叉拋物線拱撐起鞍形索網，被 ASCE 認定為世界第一座永久性索支承屋頂，並於 2002 年列為國家歷史土木工程地標。1972 年慕尼黑奧運屋蓋以等網目鞍形索網與迭代電腦計算把索網推向大規模應用；1983 年啟用的卡加利 Saddledome 以索網承托混凝土板構成雙曲面屋頂；其後輪輻式屋蓋以受壓環、受拉環與徑向索自我平衡，巴西利亞國家體育場為 2014 年世界盃改建時即採用平衡懸吊輪原理的雙層懸吊屋頂。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或張拉作業許可。~Raleigh's Dorton Arena, designed by Matthew Nowicki with Fred Severud as structural consultant and completed in 1952, carried a saddle-shaped cable net on two intersecting parabolic arches; ASCE recognises it as the world's first permanent cable-supported roof and designated it a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark in 2002. Munich's 1972 Olympic roof took cable nets to large scale with uniform-mesh saddle nets and iterative computation; Calgary's Saddledome, opened in 1983, used a cable net carrying concrete slabs to form a saddle roof; and later spoked-wheel roofs balanced themselves with compression rings, tension rings and radial cables, as in the double-layer suspended roof built on the balanced suspension-wheel principle when Brasília's National Stadium was rebuilt for the 2014 World Cup. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or tensioning authorisation.

Dorton 體育館於 2002 年獲 ASCE 列為國家歷史土木工程地標~Dorton Arena was designated a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by ASCE in 2002
慕尼黑奧運屋蓋面積約 74,000 m²，索網網目 75 × 75 cm~The Munich Olympic roof covers about 74,000 m² with a 75 × 75 cm cable-net mesh

巴西利亞國家體育場採平衡懸吊輪原理的雙層懸吊屋頂，膜面約 55,155 m²，座位約 71,000 席~Brasília's National Stadium uses a double-layer suspended roof on the balanced suspension-wheel principle, with about 55,155 m² of membrane and about 71,000 seats
卡加利 Saddledome 於 1983 年 10 月 15 日啟用，屋頂為索承混凝土反向雙曲拋物面~Calgary's Saddledome opened on 15 October 1983 with a cable-held concrete reverse hyperbolic-paraboloid roof
